description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data across three categories, labeled by year. The chart is divided into three slices. The largest slice, colored blue, represents 46.0% of the total and is labeled "(46)" alongside the percentage. The second-largest slice, colored orange, accounts for 33.0% and is labeled "(33)" and "2018". The smallest slice, colored green, makes up 21.0% and is labeled "(21)" and "2017". The chart includes percentage labels and corresponding numerical values inside each slice, but does not include a legend. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order from largest to smallest, with the blue slice starting at the top.
